# Adyog Blog

> > Technical insights on AI/ML, enterprise automation, backend engineering, and modern DevOps practices

Adyog Blog delivers in-depth technical content covering artificial intelligence advancements, database technologies, cybersecurity tools, and backend frameworks. Contributors include Kannan SP, Nirmala V Mani, and Risbin RH, focusing on practical enterprise technology solutions.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Fine-Tuning (CFT)
- AI Training & Reasoning Models
- RLHF Limitations
- PostgreSQL & TimescaleDB
- Chroma Vector Database
- Backend Engineering (Hono, Elysia, Express, Fastify)
- TruffleHog Secret Scanner
- Cloudflare
- GPT-4.5
- AI-Powered Search
- Enterprise Tech Automation
- Explainable AI
- Cybersecurity
- Database Optimization
- Model Training Paradigms
